messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple pods in inference-pool-usw reporting NodeCondition NotReady and kubelet restarts. 5xx rate for /v1/generate increased to 14% in last 3m. Paging oncall (rotation: sasha).

sasha: on it. seeing the alert. gathering context — which nodes?

PagerBot: Affected nodes: g4-infer-12, g4-infer-14, g4-infer-15. kubelet restart count increased >3 in 10m. Metric spikes: p95 latency +220ms, error budget burn accelerating.

sasha: @jules infra — can you join? Im starting triage. Also ping @marco runtime in case CUDA/driver implicated.

jules: joining. pulling node status now.

sasha: output I grabbed:

```
$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-pool-usw -o wide
NAME             STATUS    ROLES   AGE   VERSION
g4-infer-12      NotReady  <none>  32d  v1.25.6
g4-infer-14      Ready     <none> 18d  v1.25.6
g4-infer-15      NotReady  <none> 5d   v1.25.6
```

sasha: kubectl describe on g4-infer-12 shows kubelet restart and eviction churn. Logs indicate kubelet complaining about failing to sync pods and repeated OOM messages in /var/log/messages.

marco: quick check — any recent driver rollout? CUDA driver updates pushed yesterday to canary nodes?

jules: nope, infra didn't roll drivers last 24h. But I see kernel oops on g4-infer-12 around the time of first restart:

```
Mar 14 10:12:08 g4-infer-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1e.0): 79, GPU at PCI:0000:00:1e.0
Mar 14 10:12:08 g4-infer-12 kubelet[823]: E03014 10:12:12.345 kubelet.go:2087] Failed to sync pod ...: context deadline exceeded
```

marco: that Xid 79 often maps to GPU H/W or driver issues (NVIDIA). Could be intermittent GPU fault causing runtime container to crash and kubelet to flail.

sasha: immediate mitigation: route traffic away from inference-pool-usw to inference-pool-useast as hot standby. @tiffany can you change routing?

tiffany: doing manual override. We'll move 100% production traffic for redwood-bert-l to useast for 10m.

nina: support: enterprise customers on dedicated capacity in usw are getting timeouts; hosted API also sees elevated errors. We'll post to status and triage customer comms.

tiffany:

```
$ rictl routing override create --from pool=inference-pool-usw --to pool=inference-pool-useast --percent 100 --duration 10m --reason "kubelet instability in usw"
Override created: id=ovr-9f2b
```

deploy-bot: Deploy updated routing config v2026-03-14-002 to control-plane. Routing change in progress.

PagerBot: Traffic shift initiated: requests in usw dropped ~88% within 90s; p95 in useast stable.

jules: SSHing to g4-infer-12. Checking `journalctl -u kubelet -n 300` and `dmesg`.

jules: logs show repeated OOM kills and GPU watchdog resets:

```
Mar 14 10:10:56 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (runtime) total-vm:XXXXXkB, anon-rss:XXXXXkB
Mar 14 10:11:01 kubelet: eviction manager: eviction thresholds met
Mar 14 10:12:08 kernel: NVRM: Xid 79: GPU watchdog reset
```

marco: runtime-level mitigation: we can reduce batch size and disable kvcache per-route to lower GPU memory footprint temporarily.

sasha: apply conservative profile to non-enterprise hosted traffic on usw: batch_size=1, kvcache=off. @tiffany?

tiffany:

```
$ rictl model update redwood-bert-l --pool inference-pool-usw --batch-size 1 --kvcache disabled
Patch applied: rolling change.
```

PagerBot: Model profile rolled to remaining pods; memory pressure on GPUs dropped ~30%.

jules: restarted runtime container on g4-infer-12: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/runtime-gpu --namespace inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=g4-infer-12` — it came back but kernel logged Xid 79 again and kubelet restarted.

marco: repeating Xid after container restart indicates hardware/driver. Recommend replacing node.

jules: provisioning replacement now.

```
$ infractl reprovision --node g4-infer-12 --replace true --pool inference-pool-usw
job=rp-1001 queued
```

jules: new node g4-infer-22 joined cluster and is Ready. Pods rescheduled.

PagerBot: g4-infer-22 Ready at 2198766001. Pod startup times within normal.

sasha: rolling traffic back: set routing override to 30% usw to validate.

tiffany:

```
$ rictl routing override update ovr-9f2b --percent 30
Override updated: percent=30
```

PagerBot: distribution updated: ~30% to usw. P95 stable, error rate low.

nina: customer comms updated; support tickets marked mitigated. We'll keep status page note until postmortem.

sasha: handoff: I'll stay until we verify stability for 30m. Follow-ups:
- jules: hardware swap verification and kernel/driver audit (assigned jules)
- marco: implement runtime memory-backoff logic and GPU Xid alerting (assigned marco)
- tiffany: create routing playbook for region-level flaps (assigned tiffany)
- sasha: write timeline and RCA draft for postmortem (assigned sasha)

PagerBot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: Error rates returned to baseline. Routing override ovr-9f2b active at 30% for monitoring. Auto-expire in 8m unless updated.

sasha: thanks team. Scheduling postmortem. Closing thread until follow-ups complete. :white_check_mark:

jules: will update postmortem with kernel logs and hardware ticket.
